abilities.name: Commander
abilities.text: Treat this Unit's Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers, completing objectives, and resolving Disengage checks.

abilities.name: Force Wall
abilities.text: Set two Force Wall tokens Wholly Within 8″ in an unoccupied space. Units of Size 2 or lower cannot move across the Force Wall. Models of Size 3 or more can move over it, and it's then removed.

abilities.name: Khala's Gift
abilities.text: Target another Friendly Biological Unit Within 12″. Until the End of the Round, that Unit resolves its first Special Ability with the cost reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

abilities.name: Executor's Will
abilities.text: Target two Enemy Units on the battlefield (Line of Sight is not required) and place a Faction Indicator next to each of them. During the next Assault Phase, if either of these Units ends its Activation while its Faction Indicator remains on the battlefield, you may Activate two Friendly Units consecutively. Remove both Faction Indicators after any Enemy Unit completes its Activation in the following Assault Phase.

abilities.name: Psi Lightning
abilities.text: Each Unit Within 2″ of one or more Friendly Force Wall tokens suffers 1 Damage.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Push
abilities.text: Set each Friendly Force Wall token Wholly Within 6″ of its current position.
